visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a bright indoor shot of a pet enclosure area. A wooden-framed cage stands in the center, next to an oversized pink plush bear wearing a rainbow shirt. A vibrant rainbow-colored rug with daisy motifs lies on the floor. A small, fluffy brown dog wearing a yellow knit vest sits on a striped chair against a painted backdrop of a park. (2) The scene shifts to the 'MEANINGLUS' pet boutique in Myeongdong. A woman with long brown hair, wearing a white blazer and a blue bucket hat, is seen browsing racks of miniature pet clothing. Close-up shots feature pastel-colored dresses, bear-themed knits, and lace-trimmed pet apparel. The interior is modern with light wood accents and white shelving. (3) The visual transitions to the 'WIGGLE WIGGLE.ZIP' store, characterized by highly saturated green and yellow walls. The woman explores various rooms decorated with rainbow pillows, flower-shaped wall art, and whimsical furniture. A large yellow bear sculpture is a focal point. Screenshots of a web interface displaying pet accessories and their prices are periodically overlaid. (4) The final segment shows the 'Pet Street' section of a large retail store, likely Daiso. Shelves are packed with pet toys shaped like potato chip bags, ketchup bottles, and tiny sunglasses. A small dog is shown biting a blue crinkly toy on a grey carpeted floor. The video ends with the woman comparing a pet's athletic shirt to a full-sized man's shirt.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A female narrator begins speaking with a cheerful, high-pitched voice and a rapid tempo. The background music is a bouncy, major-key electronic pop track with prominent synth bass and a four-on-the-floor beat. The audio quality is clean and studio-produced. (2) As the video transitions into store footage, the narration continues with consistent energy. A subtle 'whoosh' sound effect emphasizes the scene change. The music maintains its energetic drive, with no interference from ambient shopping noises. (3) The narrator's pitch rises during the descriptions of the colorful store items. Intermittent 'pop' and 'ding' sound effects are used for visual emphasis. The electronic beat remains central, keeping the pace lively and engaging for the viewer. (4) In the final phase, short incidental noises like the crinkle of a plastic toy bag are mixed into the track. The female voice remains dominant and clear. The video concludes with a brief male voice saying a comedic line, followed by a sharp audio fade out.
